page.title: Ziswaanganya
page.intro: Swaanganya maakaunti aako aakwaambilizya. Bantu bazwa kuzisambazyo zyako balasika mu My Leads biyo, amali aasangwa amali aasangwa kuli umwi awumwi.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form litola kubantu bangu, mali aasangwa abuzuba amali aasangwa amuntu omwe, antoomwe abubotu bwakusololela bwatuminwa ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn yakaswaangana. Basikusololela bali mukujanwa lino - peeji eeli lilabambululwa muchindi chinini biyo.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn tiiyakabikkwa a seva eeyi pe. Mweendelezi weelede kuyungizya ID ya kasitoma ya LinkedIn app aamaseseke.
banner.expired: Kuswaangana kwa LinkedIn kwamana, aboobo basikusololela tabakweendelani pe. Swaanganya alimwi kuti uzumanane.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn ikuyanda kuti unjile alimwi kusikila {{date}} . Swaanganya alimwi kakutanaba chiindi eecho kuchitila kuti nzila zizumanane kweenda.

connect.title: Swaanganya LinkedIn
connect.intro: Njila a LinkedIn akaunti yeendelezya zyaambilizyo zyako. Leadrat ubala buyo ma akaunti aako aakusambala, Foomu ya Lead Gen Form antoomwe anamba zyakusambala, mpawo utumina kusanduka kwako.
connect.need1: Mulimu aakkaunti yakusambala LinkedIn (Mulangizi naa kwiinda waawo).
connect.need2: Mulimu apeeji lyakkampani lijatikizyidwe (Mweendelezi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Mulangizi naa Sikulanga-langa) - LinkedIn ilayanda kuti kwaabile bantu.
connect.need3: Mubuzyo wanamba yafooni Lead Gen Forms - basololi batakwe namba yafooni tabakonzyi kusanganyigwa pe.

connection.title: Kuswaangana
connection.syncResult: Kweendelana kwachitika: {{received}} kwatambula, {{created}} kwakalengwa, {{duplicates}} kukozyanisya, {{rejected}} kwakakilwa.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Kugwisya LinkedIn ? Kuzuminana kwamana mpawo zitondezyo zyakunjila zilagwisigwa. Zitondezyo, myeelwe antoomwe alugwalo lwamilimu zilabikkwa.
connection.noPermission: Ulakonzya kubona peeji eeli. Kuswaangana akuchincha mabambe kuyandika kuzumizigwa "Bweendelezi bwamabambe".
connection.fetchHint: Basikusololela bapya balalangwa-langwa mumaminiti masyoonto mpawo mazuba aali 7 aamamanino alalangwa-langwa alimwi abuzuba, aboobo kunyina chintu chisweekede. Belesya eechi kuzintu zikonzya kukugwasya kotaninga swaangana, naakuti kulanga chiindi alimwi (kusikila kumazuba aali 90 achiindi chomwe). Zisolo zili kale Leadrat zilalekwa.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} kwajanwa, {{created}} kwakalengwa, {{duplicates}} zikozyenye, {{rejected}} zyakakakwa, {{skipped}} zyakanjizigwa kale.

accounts.intro: Basikusololela amweelwe zilazumizyigwa kuzwa kuma akaunti aakusambala aajulwa aawa.
accounts.none: Taakwe maakaunti aakusambala aajanika aakkaunti eeyi LinkedIn . Langa mulimo wa akaunti mu LinkedIn Campaign Manager , mpawo ubweze.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Amubaambile LinkedIn kuti nguni akati kabasololi bakwe wakaba muntu uulangilwa ncobeni. Eelyo sikusololela LinkedIn nasika achiimo nchosala munsi, Leadrat ulaambilizya ku LinkedIn , kuchitila kuti malipooti aako atondezye bubotu bwakusololela mpawo LinkedIn ilakonzya kujana bantu biingi mbuli basololi bako. Buyo ID yamusololi wa LinkedIn antoomwe a hash yomwe ya imeyili zilatumwa.
capi.created: Kusanduka kwakachitwa a LinkedIn mpawo kwakabikkwa mumaapu.

activity.title: lugwalo lwamilimu
activity.intro: Zyoonse zili akati ka Leadrat a LinkedIn : zijatikizyo, kweendelana kuli koonse, kusololela kuli koonse anzyakachitika kuli ncico, kusanduka akulubizya.
